new_products.Title: FT800VC
new_products.Sub Title: Wizard Prestige IP doorphone with 4-inch HD touchscreen, 5-in-1 access control
new_products.Product Description: The FT800VC is Fasttel's flagship Wizard Prestige IP video doorphone, built in Belgium for residential and commercial entrances that demand a premium outdoor unit. It pairs a 4-inch HD colour touchscreen with five built-in access methods (facial recognition, QR code, NFC/MIFARE badge, PIN code and Bluetooth) so visitors and residents have a smooth, contactless experience at the gate. The black anodised aluminium body integrates a 160-degree HD colour camera with day/night switching, a powerful adjustable loudspeaker and a protected microphone, with 2 internal relays for gate and door control. Bidirectional video, SIP and Fasttel's cloud platform (Fasttelphone app) are supported out of the box, and the same frame accepts both flush and surface mounting. The Small variant measures 280 x 124 x 38 mm; a Large variant (FT800VC-L) is also available for installations that need more buttons or a wider plate.

new_products.Title: FT800KVC
new_products.Sub Title: Wizard Prestige IP doorphone with integrated keypad and 5-in-1 access
new_products.Product Description: The FT800KVC is the keypad-equipped version of Fasttel's Wizard Prestige IP outdoor station. It combines a 4-inch HD colour touchscreen, a 160-degree HD camera and a physical PIN keypad inside a Belgian-built black anodised aluminium body, so installers get a single product that covers visitor calling, video, facial recognition, QR code, NFC, Bluetooth and code-based entry. Two internal relays drive gate and door locks (expandable to eight via FT4SWIP), and the unit registers simultaneously to a customer SIP server and to the Fasttel cloud so residents can be reached on intercom monitors, indoor 10-inch Commander panels and the Fasttelphone smartphone app. The frame supports both surface and flush mounting from the same housing, and the small variant measures 280 x 124 x 38 mm; FT800KVC-L provides a larger plate for projects that need additional buttons or signage.

new_products.Title: FT600W
new_products.Product Description: The FT600W is Fasttel's 7-inch indoor video intercom monitor, designed as a flexible companion to the Wizard outdoor stations (FT600 Entry, Wizard Bronze IP, Wizard Elite IP and Wizard Prestige FT800 ranges). The 800 x 480 capacitive touchscreen is housed in a slim 117 x 203 x 20 mm body that can be placed anywhere there is WiFi or a network drop. PoE is supported for single-cable installation, and a 12 V adapter is available where Ethernet is not present. The monitor speaks SIP to the outdoor stations, supports ONVIF and RTSP for third-party IP cameras, has one configurable relay output (NO/COM/NC), and can act as its own WiFi bridge and DHCP server in small installations. Optional accessories include the FT600BS table stand and the FT600WPS PoE power supply.

new_products.Title: FT30CCDESK
new_products.Sub Title: Desktop base for the FT30CC Commander indoor station
new_products.Product Description: The FT30CCDESK is the desktop base accessory for Fasttel's FT30CC Commander 10-inch indoor station. It turns the wall-mount Commander into a portable desk unit by adding a ~1.5 kg copper base and routing the LAN/PoE or 12 V cable cleanly out the back, so the same touchscreen can be used as a kitchen counter or office desk intercom without permanent installation. When combined with the optional FT600WPS PoE injector the Commander can run from a standard wall outlet and connect over WiFi, making it a true plug-and-place solution for renters, hospitality projects or showroom displays. The desk base matches the FT30CC's black aluminium finish; bronze, white and matt variants of the same accessory (FTBG30CCDESK, FTW30CCDESK, FTBR30CCDESK, FTBM30CCDESK) are also available to match the corresponding Commander front plates.

new_products.Title: FT600VK
new_products.Sub Title: Plug-and-play IP video intercom kit with 7-inch monitor
new_products.Product Description: The FT600VK is Fasttel's plug-and-play IP video intercom kit, designed so a small home or office can be fully equipped from a single box. The package combines an FT600SIPVC outdoor station (single button, HD colour camera, black anodised aluminium with tempered glass), an FT600W 7-inch indoor monitor, a Fasttel PoE network switch (FT600SW) and four Fasttelphone smartphone app licences. Wiring is simplified by 100% PoE: a single Cat cable from the switch powers and networks each device, and the supplied outdoor station accepts both surface and flush installation from the same frame. The base FT600VK is the small 216 x 116 mm size; medium (FT600VK-M, 263 x 154 mm) and large (FT600VK-L, 349 x 154 mm) variants are also offered, along with FT600VK-10 versions that swap the 7-inch monitor for a 10-inch Android Commander panel.

new_products.Title: FT600VKK
new_products.Sub Title: Plug-and-play IP video intercom kit with keypad and 7-inch monitor
new_products.Product Description: The FT600VKK is the keypad-equipped version of Fasttel's plug-and-play IP video intercom kit, intended for installations that need both a video call button and a PIN-based entry option. The kit pairs an FT600KSIPVC outdoor station (1 push button, HD colour camera and integrated code keypad with 2 internal relays) with an FT600W 7-inch indoor monitor, the Fasttel FT600SW PoE switch and four Fasttelphone smartphone app licences. Everything runs on a single PoE-powered Cat run per device and supports SIP, RTSP, ONVIF and the Fasttel cloud, so the kit drops into both standalone homes and projects already running a third-party PBX. Medium (FT600VKK-L), large and 10-inch Commander variants (FT600VKK-10, FT600VKK-10-L) are also available.

new_products.Title: FT9000
new_products.Product Description: The FT9000 is Fasttel's web/cloud-managed door access controller, designed to drive up to four doors from a single IP-connected unit. It is the central brain that pairs the Fasttel intercom and keypad portfolio (FT26K, FT600 Entry, Wizard Bronze IP and Wizard Prestige FT800 series) with proper enterprise access control: card and PIN management, time profiles, schedules and logs are configured through a built-in web interface and Fasttel's cloud portal, so dealers and end-users can administer permissions from anywhere. The controller exposes Wiegand interfaces for third-party readers (FT9100 series silver/black Wiegand card readers, FT9102 fingerprint, FT9103 keypad + card, FT9104 QR reader) and integrates back into the Fasttelphone app for unified visitor management. The product complements the legacy FT9002A (2-door) and FT9004A (4-door) controllers in the Fasttel access control lineup.

new_products.Title: FT26K
new_products.Sub Title: Keypad/badge reader with Bluetooth, NFC, cloud and Wiegand
new_products.Product Description: The FT26K is Fasttel's flagship multi-technology access keypad, designed as a single thin surface module that combines a PIN keypad, an NFC/MIFARE badge reader and Bluetooth credential support. Codes, cards and Bluetooth keys can be managed locally or through the Fasttel cloud, and the FT26K speaks Wiegand to integrate with third-party access systems such as Fasttel's own FT9000/FT9002A/FT9004A controllers. A single internal relay is provided on-board, and the matching FT26K-SR security relay can be installed inside the home so the door lock contact is not exposed at the outside wall. The unit is built in black anodised aluminium (50 x 140 x 28 mm) to match the FT600 Entry and FT800 Prestige ranges, and a flush-mounting frame (FT26KBIS) is available. A QR-enabled variant (FT26K-QR) extends the same unit with QR code reading for short-term visitor access.

new_products.Title: FT23K
new_products.Sub Title: Stand-alone access keypad, black matte, Wiegand, surface-mount
new_products.Product Description: The FT23K is Fasttel's compact stand-alone access keypad, designed for surface mounting at gates, garages and side doors where a clean black matte aluminium plate is preferred. It runs autonomously with two on-board relays so it can drive a door strike and a gate motor straight from the keypad, and it also speaks Wiegand for use as a reader on a larger access control system (including Fasttel's own FT9000-series controllers). The compact 51 x 136 x 25 mm footprint matches the rest of the Fasttel keypad and intercom range, and PIN codes are managed locally. The FT23K is the entry-level companion to the bronze keypad family (FT24K, FT24BR, FTBG23KF/FTBR23KF/FTBM23KF) and to the multi-technology FT26K.

new_products.Sub Title: Bronze stand-alone access keypad with Wiegand
new_products.Product Description: The FT24K is Fasttel's bronze-finish stand-alone access keypad, intended as the entry-control companion to the Wizard Bronze IP outdoor stations and the bronze FT30CC Commander indoor panel. It uses the same solid copper construction and bronzed finishes as the rest of the Bronze range, with a 143 x 143 mm front plate, and pairs to a FT25KINT controller module for stand-alone operation. Wiegand output is provided so it can also be used as a reader on a third-party access control system, including Fasttel's FT9000-series cloud controllers. Three bronze finishes are catalogued (FTBG bronze gold matte, FTBM bronze matte, FTBR bronze rustic matte) plus an FTBX RAL custom option.

new_products.Title: FT25K
new_products.Sub Title: Stand-alone access keypad with glass front plate
new_products.Product Description: The FT25K is Fasttel's premium stand-alone access keypad with a glass front plate, sitting at the high end of the Fasttel keypad portfolio alongside the bronze FT24K and the multi-technology FT26K. It is offered in multiple glass finishes that visually match the FT800 Prestige and FT600 Entry outdoor units, so a complete entry can be specified in a single language: doorphone, keypad and visible badge reader all share the same crisp glass and aluminium aesthetic. The keypad runs autonomously and also speaks Wiegand so it can act as a reader on Fasttel's FT9000-series cloud controllers or any third-party access system. The matching FT26K-QR adds QR-code visitor access when needed.

new_products.Title: FTEMPEROR-V
new_products.Sub Title: Stainless steel entry pedestal for Fasttel intercoms
new_products.Product Description: The FTEMPEROR-V is one of Fasttel's stylish stand-alone entry pedestals, designed for driveways and gates where a Fasttel outdoor station has to live away from the wall. The pedestal is fabricated from stainless steel with a clean column profile (multiple heights are available across the FTEMPEROR family, including 150 cm, 190 cm and 250 cm variants in the FTEMPEROR-US, -U and -UB models) and accepts any of the Fasttel small-format outdoor units: FT600 Entry, Wizard Bronze IP, Wizard Elite IP and Wizard Prestige FT800. Companion pedestals (FTEMPERORSK) are sold pre-cut for the access keypad range. Custom finishes and RAL colours are available via Fasttel's FTPAINT service.
